text_block_list.text: One day, hearing a commotion on the stairs landing, I went to check and saw Aston Machan being dragged along by Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Chan-san!
Make sure you keep up with your Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Roger that, Machan.
choice_data_list: Wait, wait, what in the world are you doing?
Wait, wait, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Machan is currently training to become the class representative.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Being the Class Rep is amazing. Since there's only one per class, you stand out like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is why I apprenticed myself to the current Class Rep.
I will definitely show you that I can become a splendid Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me!
This class rep will raise a splendid apprentice, you'll see!"
A mentor and student from different grades... That said, if you want to become class rep, you could just run for it—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, here we gooo!
Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Marchin', marchin'~

Worried about what she might start doing,
I decided to follow her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho?! It seems the equipment has been left out!
Put it back where it belongs once you're done!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's fix it up real quick.
That's what a Class Rep does, after all, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—That's right.
It seems I dropped it somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you must be in quite a bind!
Leave it to this Class Representative to take full responsibility and find—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Is this the item you lost?
Someone turned it in, so I was holding onto it. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, marvelous performance! You're already getting quite natural at this!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: S-Somebody, heeeelp meee!!

text_block_list.name: Class Rep Duo
text_block_list.text: Your class rep is on her way!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: A crow suddenly attacked me, and... I, I...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she was fascinated by your shiny earrings.
I've already told Johannes Schwarz not to do it again, though.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so very much.
I won't ever forget this kindness, Class Rep!"
(Yay, *clap clap clap*!)

text_block_list.name: Watching Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Class Rep!
You're amazing, Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Most splendidly done!
You can proudly call yourself a Class Rep now!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mhu-. Amazing, Class Rep.
You're standing out ultra big time. Heh-heh, perfect.
choice_data_list: Good on you for being so helpful.
Good on you for being so helpful.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Thank you, Class Rep.
I was so surprised you could talk to crows!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Class Reps, you guys cleaned under the stairs earlier too, right? Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh my?
What's this... Something feels off—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. If I'm the Class Rep, does that mean
everyone will just call me 'Class Rep'?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Machan doesn't recall
having her name called even once for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Gah. Oh no, this is a huge miscalculation. Mar-chan is
not being Mar-chan anymore!
choice_data_list: Still, they definitely remember your face now!
Maybe we should think about a different committee...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Attacked by Crows
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, thank you for earlier.
Er—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniff*.
Machan. Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Attacked by Crows
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank you, Mar-chan.
I won't forget how you helped me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Yes.
...Ehehe, it's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I think Chan-me will pass on being
class representative after all.
However—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Maybe I could keep helping people out... just a teeny bit. Just a teeny bit.

Aston Machan says with a hint of joy.
It seemed she had gained something beyond just being remembered.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Other committees, you say...
The next morning, in front of the school gate—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I'm Aston Machan.
Call me Machan, okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Your voice carries well, sir! But I'd appreciate
it if your morning greeting was "Good morning"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Also, no need to give your name or anything!

Apparently, she's now striving in a greeting campaign as an apprentice to the Disciplinary Committee.
I watched with a smile as she gave it her best.
